events.text: my burgers came super late and the app says they were delivered around 7 but nothing was here until way later

I'm sorry about the wait. I can look into this for you. First, I need to verify your identity. Please provide your full name and either the email address or phone number on your account. If you have your order number handy, please share that too.
Leo Brandt. Phone is 415-555-0232. The order number is 7201.

events.note: Courier app marked delivered 2.1 miles from the address

events.text:
Thanks, Leo. You're verified, and I've looked into order Q-7201 from Burger Barn.

Here's what the records show:
- **Promised by:** 7:00 PM
- **Handed to you:** 7:47 PM, in person. The courier's app marked it delivered at 6:58 PM, but that was 2.1 miles from your address, so it wasn't a real handoff. The 7:47 handoff is the one that counts.
- **Lateness:** 47 minutes past the promised time.

Because the order arrived more than 45 minutes late, I've added **$5.60 in account credit** to your Forkful account. That's 20% of the $28.00 food subtotal. The credit is available for your next order.

I can't refund it to your card, since late deliveries are compensated with account credit only. Is there anything else I can help with?

Okay, so the app said 6:58 and it was really 7:47? I was home the whole time and nothing came until 7:45, so 47 minutes late is about right. The credit helps a bit, but I'd rather have the money back on my card, since I'm not ordering from you again just to use up $5.60. Can you tell me why it has to be credit only?

You're right about the timing. The app's 6:58 PM "delivered" time came from the courier's app, which marked the order delivered while the courier was 2.1 miles from your address. The courier didn't hand the food to you until 7:47 PM, so that's the time I used. Your account of arriving home and waiting until about 7:45 matches the records.

As for why the compensation is credit only: Forkful's policy is that late-delivery compensation is issued as account credit, not a refund to the card. I don't have the reasons behind that rule, and I can't make an exception to it. I also can't add to the $5.60 or convert it to a card refund.

Your options are:
- Keep the $5.60 credit on your account for a future order.
- Tell me if you'd like a different kind of help with this order. I can only look at the items, the payment, and the delivery records.

Is there anything else I can check for you?

Fair enough, I guess. Credit only, and I can't even pick what kind of help I get. Honestly, the thing that bugs me most is the app saying it was delivered at 7 when nothing was here. Can you at least flag that so it doesn't happen again to someone else?

I'm sorry the app showed a delivery time that didn't match what happened. I understand why that's frustrating.

I don't have a way to file a bug report or flag app issues, and I can't escalate this to a specialist, since it doesn't fall under the situations where I'm allowed to escalate. I also can't confirm that this feedback will reach the team that fixes the app.

I can't guarantee anything will change, but you can send the details directly to Forkful's app feedback channel: the order number Q-7201, the 6:58 PM "delivered" time, and the 7:47 PM handoff.

I also want to correct my last message. I said you couldn't pick what kind of help you'd get, but that wasn't accurate. The only compensation I can give on this order is the $5.60 credit I've already added.

Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Alright, that's something at least. I'll send the feedback through the app channel myself. I'm not going to keep arguing about the $5.60, so I'll take the credit. That's all I need from you today.

events.note: Courier app marked delivered 2.1 miles from the address
